name: How does improving home insulation contribute to overall energy efficiency during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does improving home insulation contribute to overall energy efficiency during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improving home insulation during a remodel significantly enhances overall energy efficiency by creating a more effective thermal barrier. This reduces heat transfer between your living space and the outdoors, meaning your HVAC system doesn't have to work as hard to maintain a comfortable temperature. For instance, upgrading attic or wall insulation lessens the load on your air conditioner in the DFW summer and your furnace in winter. This foundational upgrade is crucial for maximizing the performance of other energy-efficient systems and ensures long-term comfort and cost savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improved insulation creates a stronger thermal barrier, reducing heat transfer and lessening the workload on your HVAC system, leading to better energy efficiency, especially in the DFW climate.
